plan.direction: Long-only spot reversal after a completed UTC 4h downside move, with fixed rebound or time exit.
plan.hypothesis: Primary Bitcoin intraday research reports negative return autocorrelation at 1h, 2h and 4h horizons and stronger percentage reversal after larger moves. Test a simple 4h close-to-close downside threshold in current BTC/ETH spot data; no claim that the paper's effect persists or survives current costs.

source_paper.citation: De Nicola, G. (2021). On the Intraday Behavior of Bitcoin. Ledger, 6. DOI:10.5195/ledger.2021.213.
source_paper.reported_finding: The paper reports significant negative first-order autocorrelation on 1h, 2h and 4h returns and stronger percentage reversals after larger moves. It uses historical BTC data; this batch separately tests Binance BTC/ETH under explicit current cost assumptions.

plan.rule: For each newly completed UTC 4h bar j, calculate simple close-to-close return close[j]/close[j-1]-1. If flat and return <= -entry_drop_fraction (equality qualifies), buy at the first 1m open one minute after the next UTC 4h block begins; store close[j] as recovery_reference. While long, exit when a later completed 4h close >= recovery_reference or elapsed completed 4h bars since entry execution >= max_holding_4h_bars. Exit has priority; after an exit signal, do not re-enter on that decision bar. A rejected entry is not retried/backfilled; a rejected exit remains held and is reconsidered only at later completed 4h decisions. Force a costed terminal liquidation at the first executable minute after the common OOS end if filters permit.

time_boundaries.walk_forward: 12 contiguous, non-overlapping 30-day folds (180 4h bars each); unlevered account state carries through folds; parameters are frozen before evaluation.
time_boundaries.reuse_disclosure: This interval is repeatedly used repository development/validation history and is not an untouched final holdout.

execution.market: Binance spot historical 1m open as a scheduled reference, after closed 4h signal availability plus a fixed 60-second buffer.
execution.positioning: Independent 2,000 USDT account per asset and configuration; long-only, one position at a time, no leverage, transfers, yield, or add-ons.
execution.terminal: Costed liquidation at OOS end, subject to current frozen exchange filters.

costs.impact: 0.5 × prior 20 complete UTC daily return sample standard deviation × sqrt(order quote budget / prior 20 complete UTC daily quote-volume ADV)
costs.depth_limit: No historical L2 snapshots in this experiment; spread and impact are estimates, with exchange filters/participation explicitly enforced.

failure_gates.interpretation: Any pass applies only to repeatedly used historical screening data and is not independent or live-profit evidence.
